paragraphs.text: That is, move our hearts with his Holy Spirit, that we may feel his favour toward us.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: cause his face to shine upon

paragraphs.text: That both Jews and Gentiles may know God's covenant made with them.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: thy way may be known upon

paragraphs.text: By these repetitions he shows that the people can never rejoice and give thanks enough for the great benefits that they will receive under the kingdom of Christ.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: O let the nations be glad

paragraphs.text: He shows that where God favours there will be abundance of all other things.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: When they feel his great benefits both spiritual and corporal toward them.
paragraphs.label: e
